item.title: US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser Thursday to shoot down a “seemingly threatening” drone flying near the U.S.-Mexico border. It turned out the drone belonged to Customs and Border Protection, lawmakers said. item.title: HEMSI: Four students taken to hospital after Huntsville School bus involved in traffic incident
item.description: Huntsville City Schools say one student was taken to the hospital and two others may need medical attention after a traffic incident involving a school bus.

item.title: Gov. Ivey signs law eliminating out-of-pocket costs for prostate cancer screenings
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey has signed legislation into law eliminating out-of -pocket costs for prostate cancer screenings, a move supporters say will improve early detection and save lives across Alabama.

item.title: 19-year-old accused of sexually abusing girl for over a year faces dozens of charges in Colbert County
item.description: COLBERT COUNTY, Ala. (WHNT) — A 19-year-old is facing dozens of charges in Colbert County after court documents said he had been sexually abusing a 13-year-old girl for over a year.

item.title: Historic Showdown: Alabama A&M to compete in first-ever HBCU Baseball game at Wrigley Field
item.description: For the first time in history, two elite Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs), Alabama A&M University and Prairie View A&M University, will face off at Wrigley Field, the iconic home of the Chicago Cubs, for a groundbreaking celebration of culture, legacy, and the game of baseball.
